speakerTurns.speaker: W
speakerTurns.text: Hey, Oliver. Did you see the focus group results for our new spicy cheddar cheese? Everyone really liked it.

speakerTurns.speaker: M
speakerTurns.text: Yes. It should be a great addition to our company's line of cheeses.

speakerTurns.speaker: W
speakerTurns.text: Several people mentioned that they'd like to use it in recipes-to add to sauces, for example.

speakerTurns.speaker: M
speakerTurns.text: So maybe we should consider selling a shredded version that would melt easily when cooked.

speakerTurns.speaker: W
speakerTurns.text: I'm sure we could do that. I'll get in touch with the production manager with that request.
